title: 3,3′-Selenobis(1-Benzyl-2-Oxo-1,2-Dihydropyridine-4-Carbaldehyde)
content: Selenium compounds have garnered significant attention in the field of medicinal chemistry due to their unique biochemical properties and potential therapeutic applications for different pa-thologies. In this study, we report the synthesis of a new selenylated bis-pyridone compound using SeO2 as the source of selenium. The detailed characterizations 1H and 13C NMR and mass spectral analysis are given.
